searchText: Hello! it looks like the devnet5 explorer at http://134.209.87.158:8080/ is not sync. Any idea? I just noticed this, I assume that the `signer(tx).balance` check should also include `tx.value`? the idea is that the EIP gives things _beyond_ what the client would already do; so all of the existing checks apply and this one is called out bc you also need to incorporate the data gas as part of the fee payment I completely understand why you want to make this complex EIP spec to be minimized as much as possible without dumping semi-unrelated checks in there. However, it does incorporate the `tx.gas * tx_max_fee_per_gas` as well, and the client already checked that previously, so that point would also apply to that part, right? I don't want to start bike shedding here though, feel free to dismiss my point > The precompile MUST reject non-canonical field elements (i.e. provided field elements MUST be strictly less than `BLS_MODULUS`). I have no idea what inputs are the "field elements" as a crypto novice. Which inputs should I check against `BLS_MODULUS`? <asn_d6> > <asn_d6> replying to: ```@testing4844_bot wrote: <Jochem Brouwer (jochem-brouwer)> > The precompile MUST reject non-canonical field elements (i.e. provided field elements MUST be strictly less than `BLS_MODULU...``` this is done by the precompile itself <asn_d6> u just pass bytes to it and it does the verification internally I see. Is this in the 4844 tests also? https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/releases/tag/v0.2.5 that release I think it's missing the precompile tests, the tests are already merged on the main branch (https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/pull/104) but we have not yet released them give me a second I'll fill them out and post the file here Great, thanks 🙂 These do not yet implement the endianess change though, so just keep that in mind 🙂 Great, thanks 😄 Hi Mario, for all tests which fail on our side we get `Error: versioned hash does not start with KZG commitment version` I checked, and if I run this: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/releases/tag/v0.2.5 then there are 3 tests which produce this error as well (but in those tests, this error should indeed be raised). On this fixture you sent, these data hashes indeed do not start with 1. Did something change in the spec or in the test format? (Maybe we are loading them wrong as well) You're right, it's missing this PR 😓 https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/pull/126 Ahh ok, np 🙂 I will disable this KZG commitment version check to see if we pass 🙂 Cool, we do 👍 Updated the fixtures 🙌 <@508125616940515329> Thanks, we also pass those 😄

excerpts.author: jochembrouwer
excerpts.content: I just noticed this, I assume that the `signer(tx).balance` check should also include `tx.value`?

excerpts.author: ralexstokes
excerpts.content: the idea is that the EIP gives things _beyond_ what the client would already do; so all of the existing checks apply and this one is called out bc you also need to incorporate the data gas as part of the fee payment

excerpts.author: jochembrouwer
excerpts.content:
I completely understand why you want to make this complex EIP spec to be minimized as much as possible without dumping semi-unrelated checks in there.

However, it does incorporate the `tx.gas * tx_max_fee_per_gas` as well, and the client already checked that previously, so that point would also apply to that part, right?
